intervention: Replace hard-label source CE with exact conditional source CE in gradient/proposal and nonlinear acceptance; same 512 source inputs

source_loss.posterior: known GMM: raw log odds=8*(x1-0.5), computed analytically after inverse fixed coordinate transform
source_loss.source_inputs: exact original 512 samples, same complete source permutation per attempt
source_loss.interpretation: Exact conditional label expectation on a finite source input set; not exact integration over source x or a production-method replacement

branch_rules.source_ce_ggn: source-only GGN and Armijo without boundary objective/budget
branch_rules.zero_zeta_geometry: own current boundaries, zero requests still solved, empty anchors skipped
branch_rules.population: own current boundaries, unchanged population requests, empty/all-zero requests skipped

control_stationarity.expected: source-only and zero-request controls stay at the source Bayes initialization within numerical tolerance
control_stationarity.reporting: retain actual accept/reject/skip reasons and tiny numerical moves; assertion is checked after each trajectory

audit.gradient: independent VJP of softmax(logits)*sum(posterior)-posterior on all 512 samples
audit.acceptance_ce: independent logsumexp minus probability-weighted logits for every backtracking trial
audit.one_hot_regression: all three paths reproduce their existing hard-label counterparts within 1e-11

evaluation.seal: seal all new adaptation checkpoints and predictions before any synthetic target-label decoding
evaluation.diagnostics: same independent 32768 source samples, 10000 target samples and 256 boundary probes as preceding replay; initial plus every saved round
metrics: error confidence and four-cohort NLL changes
training conditional CE and hard CE as separate records
acceptance, backtracks, gradient and parameter drift
comparisons: within-arm posterior CE versus archived hard CE
evaluation.aggregation: paired seed differences, mean and sample SD within dimension; failed cells retained separately

archive: independent immutable local bundle with logs, all round states and candidates, posterior targets, final classifiers, diagnostic inputs/logits/geometry, code/environment and SHA256; GitHub publishes scalar records and report
